topics.title: Ownership, Move Semantics & Copy Trait
topics.objective: Understand single-owner semantics, stack vs heap allocation, and value movement without garbage collection.
topics.example: let s1 = String::from('hello'); let s2 = s1; // s1 moved
topics.exercise: Write a function that accepts ownership of a vector, modifies it, and returns the modified vector.

topics.title: Borrowing & References
topics.objective: Enforce mutable and immutable borrowing rules at compile time.
topics.exercise: Implement an in-place string trimmer that borrows an input slice and returns a trimmed sub-slice.

topics.title: Lifetimes & Borrow Checker Annotations
topics.objective: Annotate generic lifetime parameters to prevent dangling pointer references.
topics.example: fn longest<'a>(x: &'a str, y: &'a str) -> &'a str
topics.exercise: Create a struct holding string slices with explicit lifetime annotations and implement an accessor method.

topics.title: Result and Option Enums with Question Mark Operator
topics.objective: Master idiomatic zero-cost error propagation using Result<T, E> and Option<T>.
topics.exercise: Build a config parser that reads key-value pairs from a file and returns Result<HashMap<String, String>, ConfigError>.

topics.title: Fearless Concurrency with Arc and Mutex
topics.objective: Share mutable state safely across threads using Atomic Reference Counting and Mutual Exclusion locks.
topics.exercise: Implement a parallel word counter using 4 worker threads sharing an Arc<Mutex<HashMap<String, usize>>>.
